description: "Give me the satellite image of Los Angeles on 2026-09-10" — build a ready-to-fetch NASA GIBS image tile URL for a layer, a date and a place. Give a latitude/longitude and a zoom level and it computes the WMTS tile row/column for you; give tile_row/tile_col directly if you already have them. Returns the tile URL plus the tile's own geographic bounds and the resolved date, so the caller can show or download the actual imagery.

date.description: Date YYYY-MM-DD. Omit to use the layer's most recent available date.

latitude.description: Latitude of the point the tile should cover. Required unless tile_row/tile_col are given.

longitude.description: Longitude of the point the tile should cover.

projection.description: Tile projection: "epsg4326" (geographic lat/lon, default), "epsg3857" (Web Mercator, the Leaflet/Google tile scheme), "epsg3413" (Arctic polar), "epsg3031" (Antarctic polar). Latitude/longitude are converted for epsg4326 and epsg3857 only; the two polar projections need tile_row/tile_col.

tile_col.description: WMTS tile column, if you already know it.

tile_row.description: WMTS tile row, if you already know it (alternative to latitude/longitude).

zoom.description: Zoom level / TileMatrix, 0 = whole globe. Default 4. Capped at the layer's deepest level.

name: gibs_tile_url
